muc.title: AI and plagiarism
muc.text: Handing in AI's text word for word is plagiarism, but using AI the right way can make your essay much better.

muc.title: Use AI to argue with you
muc.text: Use AI to find ideas and debate: ask it to challenge your argument and point out weak spots, not to write it for you.

muc.title: Check every source yourself
muc.text: AI often makes up references that sound very real, so for every source you cite, find it and open the original yourself.

muc.title: Say how you used AI
muc.text: Read your school's rules on AI, and say clearly in your essay what you used AI for, like finding ideas or fixing spelling.

muc.title: Three weak spots
muc.text: Write the main argument of the essay you're about to hand in, ask AI to point out three weak spots, then rewrite that part in your own words.
